name: @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem
description: Official Model Context Protocol server for local filesystem access. Enables AI agents to read, list, and modify files within designated allowed paths.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read complete UTF-8 contents of a file from an allowed path.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write content to a file at an allowed path.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List files and directories contained within a given path.

tools.name: get_file_info
tools.description: Retrieve metadata (size, creation time, permissions) for a file or directory.
